# keyframes.js — the agent index (llms.txt)

> CSS keyframe animations for anything in JavaScript. Parse author
> `@keyframes`, animate any object or DOM element, and round-trip it
> BACK to CSS. Every capability below is backed by a CI-verified
> `proof:*` gate — this index is GENERATED from the machine-checked
> published surface (`docs/published-surface.md`) and cannot drift
> from it (`proof:agent-surface`).

The three axes only kf has: [axis-1] author CSS is the source format
(round-trippable — parse AND serialize); [axis-2] perceptual color
(oklab lerp, ΔE-conformant — see the color-fidelity harness); [axis-3]
a static/dynamic boundary (a value.js-free LIGHT tier + a `loadAnimationEngine()`
HEAVY tier).

Install: `npm i @mkbabb/keyframes.js` · README: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md

## Primitives (each backed by a runnable proof gate)

### CSSKeyframesAnimation  (HEAVY+LIGHT)
- intent: parse author CSS @keyframes → animate any element/object; the round-trippable source-of-truth axis [axis-1]
- exports: `CSSKeyframesAnimation`, `Animation`, `loadAnimationEngine`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#csskeyframesanimation
- proof: `proof:roundtrip-fidelity` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:roundtrip-fidelity`)

### animate  (HEAVY)
- intent: the single-call front door: construct + target + play, dispatched on input shape (CSS string / vars / motion-path spec)
- exports: `animate`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#animate
- proof: `proof:engine-correctness` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:engine-correctness`)

### AnimationGroup  (HEAVY)
- intent: composite many animations with replace/add/weighted layer blending (spatial composition)
- exports: `AnimationGroup`, `defaultLayerConfig`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#animationgroup
- proof: `proof:blend` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:blend`)

### Sequence  (LIGHT)
- intent: master-playhead temporal orchestration beside AnimationGroup's spatial blend
- exports: `Sequence`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#sequence
- proof: `proof:orchestration` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:orchestration`)

### compileToCSS  (HEAVY)
- intent: the round-trip's BACKWARD half: an orchestration graph → a pure zero-runtime CSS artifact (the parser run backward; GSAP/Motion cannot do this) [axis-1]
- exports: `compileToCSS`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#the-dynamic-engine--loadanimationengine
- proof: `proof:compile-replay` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:compile-replay`)

### fromStyleSheets  (HEAVY)
- intent: INGEST: read the live web's own CSS @keyframes back into kf animations (CSSOM → CSSKeyframesAnimation), CORS-skip diagnostics never a silent drop [axis-1]
- exports: `fromStyleSheets`, `fromLiveAnimations`, `adoptRunning`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#the-dynamic-engine--loadanimationengine
- proof: `proof:ingest-replay` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:ingest-replay`)

### ScrollScene  (HEAVY)
- intent: scroll-driven animation as CSS: parse animation-timeline/-range, drive on the compositor where eligible and shipped physics where not, serialize back to valid CSS [axis-1]
- exports: `ScrollScene`, `createScrollScene`, `roundTripScrollCSS`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#timeline
- proof: `proof:scroll-roundtrip` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:scroll-roundtrip`)

### SpringProgress  (LIGHT)
- intent: closed-form spring physics tracker; reseatToSpring for velocity-continuous interruption; the linear() twin is round-trippable
- exports: `SpringProgress`, `reseatToSpring`, `probeVelocity`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#springprogress
- proof: `proof:spring-blend-weight` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:spring-blend-weight`)

### springTimingFunction  (LIGHT)
- intent: spring physics → a typed Easing ({ fn, css }) / a CSS linear() stops string — a spring you can hand to native CSS [axis-1]
- exports: `springTimingFunction`, `springLinearStops`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#springlinearstops--springtimingfunction
- proof: `proof:roundtrip-easing` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:roundtrip-easing`)

### stagger  (LIGHT)
- intent: pure construction-time per-index delay distribution (materializes into the compiled CSS)
- exports: `stagger`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#stagger
- proof: `proof:orchestration` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:orchestration`)

### Timeline  (LIGHT)
- intent: progress driver (sample → clamp → easing → boundary-snap → smoothing); ScrollTimeline/ManualTimeline/createNativeTimeline variants — the caller owns the loop
- exports: `Timeline`, `ScrollTimeline`, `ManualTimeline`, `createNativeTimeline`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#timeline
- proof: `proof:sync-step` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:sync-step`)

### NumericAnimation  (LIGHT)
- intent: zero-alloc keyframe interpolation over { key: number } objects — animate any plain object, no DOM
- exports: `NumericAnimation`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#numericanimation
- proof: `proof:zero-alloc` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:zero-alloc`)

### loadAnimationEngine  (LIGHT)
- intent: the one gateway to the HEAVY tier: an awaited dynamic import that carries the CSS parser + value.js; light-only consumers never pay it [axis-3]
- exports: `loadAnimationEngine`
- docs: https://github.com/mkbabb/keyframes.js/blob/master/README.md#the-dynamic-engine--loadanimationengine
- proof: `proof:boundary` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:boundary`)

## Agent authoring loop

kf validates + compiles; the LLM generates and fixes. The forward
direction of the moat — the first question to ask before suggesting kf:
"will this `@keyframes` block ship faithfully?" `validate(css)` answers
it as one flat envelope (no message-scraping); `explain(css)` formats the
SAME verdict human/LLM-readable. Both ride `loadAnimationEngine()` (HEAVY).

```ts
const { validate, explain } = await loadAnimationEngine();

const result = await validate(css);
if (!result.parseable) {
    // fix parse errors — inspect result.diagnostics (stable .code, never scrape)
}
if (!result.eligible) {
    // inspect result.refusals (named reason per child); offer JS playback
}
if (!result.waapi.eligible) {
    // note result.waapi.reason; the animation runs on rAF, still correct
}
// if result.eligible: offer the compileToCSS output (zero-runtime CSS)

// explain(css) returns the same verdict as deterministic human-readable text:
console.log(await explain(css));
```

proof: `proof:agent-validate` (CI-verified — `npm run proof:agent-validate`)

See `/llms-full.txt` for the inline round-trip recipe (parse → animate
→ serialize) and the COMPLETE export roster (every LIGHT + HEAVY
export, the surface a `npm i` consumer reaches).
